{{Quote|The Corporate Alliance will never allow this to happen.|Voe Atell, on a Separatist bill for peace|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
'''Voe Atell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served in the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Parliament]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An affiliate of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], she remained staunchly opposed to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout the war, as were many of her colleagues in the Separatist Parliament. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Atell refused to support Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri's]] [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|bill]] to open peace negotiations with the Republic. Although the bill passed by a majority in the Parliament, it proved to be unsuccessful once it reached the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] due to the machinations of the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. As the war continued, Atell consented to serve with [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]] [[Bec Lawise/Legends|Bec Lawise]] on a Separatist delegation at the first-ever [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] with the Republic on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], in which she demanded that the Republic representatives&mdash;Senators [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]&mdash;confer [[Politics/Legends|political]] legitimacy on the Confederacy. As with Bonteri's bill for peace, the negotiations on Mandalore failed, thanks in part to an interruption from the former Separatist [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Say it aloud before this gathering, as representative for Chancellor Palpatine that you declare without reservation the Separatist State ''legitimate''.|Voe Atell, to Padmé Amidala, during the peace conference on Mandalore|<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of a [[Voe Atell's species/Legends|green-skinned, horned species]], Voe Atell<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a [[Politics/Legends|politician]], she opposed the Republic and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a breakaway government [[Raxus Address/Legends|formed]]<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] and [[Head of State/Legends|headed]] by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Confederacy waged [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war on the Republic in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] in what became known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Atell became a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]], being affiliated with the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]. As part of her duties, Atell attended Parliament sessions at the [[Separatist Senate Building/Legends|Separatist Senate Building]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

[[File:AtellSepVote-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|Atell and other Separatist senators vote against Bonteri's bill for peace negotiations.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second year of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 7: Katuunko">{{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}</ref> Separatist Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]]<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="Encyclopedia: Bonteri">{{SWE|characters|minabonteri|Mina Bonteri}}</ref>&mdash;collaborating with an old friend, Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]&mdash;introduced a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|bill]] to immediately open peace negotiations with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the Republic, as she and Amidala believed that the war had consumed enough lives since its [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outset]]. Atell took to the floor against Bonteri, swearing that the Corporate Alliance would never support such a bill for peace with the Republic. Her statement was rebutted by<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Senator [[Kerch Kushi/Legends|Kerch Kushi]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> who proclaimed that the Parliament was a democracy, uncontrolled by corporate interests like the Corporate Alliance, as the Republic was. When [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku called for a voice vote in accordance with the [[Bylaws of Independent Systems/Legends|Bylaws of Independent Systems]], Atell and a number of other senators voted nay, but they were outvoted by Bonteri and other supporters of the peace initiative. Although the proposal for peace negotiations was extended to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]], Dooku&mdash;who was secretly a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and sought to have the war continue to serve the purposes of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]]&mdash;had the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] execute a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|sneak attack]] on the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which portrayed the peace initiative as insincere in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the Republic Senate.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Dooku also had Bonteri [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|murdered]]<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/episode-guide-a-friend-in-need|text="A Friend in Need" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> and, alleging that she had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a Republic attack, cited her death as a reason to formally withdraw the Separatist Parliament's peace bill.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

Later in the war, Atell agreed to serve with [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]] [[Bec Lawise/Legends|Bec Lawise]] and Senator [[Amita Fonti/Legends|Amita Fonti]] on a delegation that was to represent the Confederacy at the first-ever [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] with the Republic. The neutral world of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] was selected as a meeting ground, with [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] hosting the gathering in the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. Bringing a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] to the Sundari docks, Atell and her colleagues arrived at the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Sundari Royal Palace]] with a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] retinue of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], while the delegates from the Republic Senate&mdash;Padmé Amidala, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]&mdash;brought [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]], along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Opening the meeting, Amidala stated that despite the tragedy of war, there was nothing that the Republic could do that would change everything that had already happened since the conflict's beginning. Speaking for her colleagues, Atell wasted no time in demanding that Amidala, being a representative of Chancellor Palpatine<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> and the leader of the Republic delegation,<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> admit to the legitimacy of the Confederacy,<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> an acknowledgment that the Republic had been withholding since the establishment of the Separatist state.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

Amidala hesitated to meet Atell's request, but before she could respond, she was interrupted by an uninvited individual, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]]. The son of Mina Bonteri, the young Bonteri had replaced his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] in the Separatist Parliament before recently renouncing his ties to the Confederacy. Taking a stand, Bonteri announced before the conference his discovery that Count Dooku had murdered his mother. Lawise immediately lambasted Bonteri's words as lies and had their BX-series [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] remove Bonteri from the room. Although Kryze protested, Atell stated that the matter was an internal affair,<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> preventing the Republic or the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] from intervening as per protocol.<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> Once Bonteri had been escorted away by the [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], Lawise apologized for the interruption and resumed the talks. In spite of efforts on both sides, the negotiations on Mandalore soon broke down<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> due to obstructions from covert interests on both sides,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mothma">{{SWE|characters|mon-mothma|Mon Mothma}}</ref> with Atell and her colleagues unable to reach an accord with the Republic senators. In the meantime, Bonteri was rescued from the Confederate [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] by Tano, who was friends with the ex-Separatist and helped him escape from custody.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Stop this!''"<br />"''We would ask you to respect that we deal with this matter ourselves.|Satine Kryze and Voe Atell, on arresting Lux Bonteri|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
[[File:Peace_conference.png|thumb|right|250px|Atell and her Separatist delegation convene with the Republic representatives on Mandalore.]]
A member of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Voe Atell had [[Color/Legends|red]] eyes and green skin, with a double row of horns on her head.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> She possessed enough political acumen to serve as a senator of the Separatist Parliament. Her ties to the Corporate Alliance were likened by some of her colleagues to the corporate interests that influenced the same Republic that she opposed. She was immediately opposed to Mina Bonteri's bill for peace negotiations, going so far as to declare that the Corporate Alliance would never allow the Parliament to pass such a proposal. In spite of her anti-peace stance,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> she later accepted a place on the Separatist delegation that was sent to the peace conference with the Republic on Mandalore. She was a firm advocate for the legitimacy of the Separatists, making her first order of business to demand that Padmé Amidala offer formal recognition to the Confederacy. When both Satine Kryze and the Republic delegation protested to the Separatists' arrest of Lux Bonteri, Atell cited the matter as an internal affair, preventing outside intervention from inhibiting the situation.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Atell wore a set of robes to official proceedings of the Separatist Parliament.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /><ref name="A Friend in Need" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character of Voe Atell was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. She was introduced in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], being one of the first Separatist senators to be featured in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], in the episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," which aired on [[November 19]], [[2010]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> She later made an appearance in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[A Friend in Need]]," which was released on [[January 13]], [[2012]].<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> In both episodes, she was voiced by actress [[Catherine Taber]], who also voiced Padmé Amidala for the series.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /><ref name="A Friend in Need" />
